# PLC Blog - Copilot Instructions

This is a Next.js-based personal blog website dedicated to PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) topics.

## Project Setup

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [ ] Setup Next.js project structure
- [ ] Configure Markdown content system
- [ ] Setup blog features (categories, tags, search, comments)
- [ ] Configure dark mode
- [ ] Install dependencies
- [ ] Test and launch

## Technology Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (React)
- **Content**: Markdown files
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Dark Mode**: next-themes
- **Features**: Categories, tags, search, comments (Giscus), dark mode
- **Deployment**: Ready for Vercel

## Project Structure

```
/PLC-blog
├── public/          # Static assets
├── src/
│   ├── app/        # Next.js app router
│   ├── components/ # React components
│   ├── lib/        # Utility functions
│   ├── styles/     # Global styles
│   └── content/    # Blog posts (Markdown)
├── package.json
├── next.config.js
├── tailwind.config.js
└── README.md
```
